name: Decky MOD Manager
author: local
description: Gamepad-first MOD manager for Steam Deck Game Mode. Detect installed games and their mods, install from a local ZIP or a direct download, enable/disable, uninstall and roll back. No root, no read-only toggle, no universal one-click install.

publish.description: Browse your Steam library and the mods each game actually has, import a mod ZIP (or fetch one over HTTPS), enable/disable it, uninstall it, and roll back a bad install. Ships with Stardew Valley / SMAPI support in detect-only mode; other games are identified read-only until a descriptor is added.
